introduction.en: Land reforms were a cornerstone of post-independence economic policy, aimed at restructuring the agrarian economy to ensure social justice and enhance agricultural productivity.
introduction.hi: Land reforms were a cornerstone of post-independence economic policy, aimed at restructuring the agrarian economy to ensure social justice and enhance agricultural productivity.

body.en: The primary objectives included the abolition of the Zamindari system, imposition of land ceilings, and regulation of tenancy. However, success was limited due to the lack of political will, legal loopholes like benami transfers, and poor maintenance of land records. These factors prevented the equitable redistribution of land and hindered the modernization of agriculture.

conclusion.en: To revitalize the rural economy, there is a need for a second generation of land reforms focusing on digital land records, clear land titles, and progressive land leasing laws.
